entities.summary: Margaret Chant-Papandreou is a Greek-American activist, writer, author and columnist who served as the first lady of Greece from 1981 to 1989, as the wife of Prime Minister Andreas Papandreou. Among her children are the Prime Minister of Greece George Papandreou (2009–2011), and the Member of the European Parliament Nikos Papandreou.
